drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find proposed revisions adding standard mutual NDA protections, including a purpose-limited use restriction, customary exclusions, representative access, compelled-disclosure procedures, and return or destruction obligations. We have retained the proposed twenty-four-month agreement term and clarified the three-year confidentiality period. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and entity details for signature.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of either party (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other (the “Receiving Party”) in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential, including analyses derived from such information and the existence and status of the parties’ discussions. Confidential Information excludes information the Receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available without breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without a confidentiality obligation before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality obligation; or (d) is independently developed without use of Confidential Information.

2. MUTUAL OBLIGATIONS. In consideration of the parties’ mutual promises, each Receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its directors, officers, employees, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement or professional duties of confidentiality. The Receiving Party is responsible for their compliance. If disclosure is legally compelled, the Receiving Party may disclose only what is legally required and, to the extent legally permitted, shall provide prompt advance notice and reasonable cooperation, at the Disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except copies required by law or professional retention requirements and routine inaccessible backup copies; retained information remains subject to this Agreement. No license or other intellectual property right is granted by disclosure.

3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The confidentiality and use restrictions survive for three years after each disclosure; information qualifying as a trade secret shall remain protected for as long as it qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law. Neither party is obligated to disclose information or proceed with any transaction. Any transaction requires a separate definitive agreement signed by both parties.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages alone may be inadequate. The affected party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to any other available remedies.
